content: Yesu a bagibagi taniwagana

Iyeta gehouna numa dalabu baneina u hinena Yesu lawa iatatiyehi po ugolihi tuwega dewadewana i guuguyeya, ma tu witalaguyaba babadahi po lugagayo tanitaniwagahi, mi Yudeya hai tanitaniwaga mitehi hi nei,
po ugolina hi pa, ‘Una paliweliyai, witaniwaga awai u waya po geka ginoulihi e dewadewahi, bo iyai geka witaniwagana i welem?’
Yesu hai baha i wimiheya i pa, ‘Hapali tau gasi u lubayada a welemi. Ona paliweleu,
Yoni a witaniwaga yadei i nei bo lawa ugolihiyei i nei po i ibapatiso?’
Ma tuawahi u hayahi hi ibaabani hi pa, ‘Apo awai ta baheya? Apo tana pa, “Yadei,” apo ina pa, “Awai binei ega ota witumaganeya?”
Ma apo tana pa, “Lawa ugolihiyei,” apo lawa atapuhi hina lugaimata. Matababana u nugonugohi i kadidili duma naka Yoni tauna tu bahapiko gehouna.’
Ega yaka a baha hi wimiheya hi pa, ‘Ega tota hanapugeya miyei i nei.’
Ma Yesu ugolihi i baha i pa, ‘Tau gasi apega a paliwelemi witaniwaga awai a waya po geka ginoulihi a dewadewahi.’
Lawa gehouna a tano tu bagibaiyena ompaliluwaluwana

Apoma Yesu i tugudu po geka paliluwaluwana lawa i paliwelehi i pa, ‘Lawa gehouna gologolowa ugona ugolina wine he dewadewaya i lupehiyeya. Ma tano tu galena itete u nimahi i houni ma i nae dobu mawana daodaona ugolina.

Omlohina hougana ugolina badana a hewali i himili po i nae tano tu galena itete ugolihi ipa ugona tupona hina weleya. Tamogi tano tu galena itete baha tu hihiwa hi wilawi ma a nima kwakwawina hi himili po i gunawileya.
Ega yaka badana a hewali gehouna i himili po tauna gasi hi wilawi po i wihinimaya ma a nima kwakwawina hi himili po i gunawileya.
Ma a tu bagibagi witonugana i himili po gegeka naka kelo hi weleya ma tano u putana hi dubala hopuneya.
‘Apoma tanona taniwagana i baha i pa, “Apo awai a dewaya? Heki, natu hotau a lauhogalena dumaya a himili, nugote apo hina wiyateyateya.”
‘Tamogi hougana tano tu galena itete natunana hi gagaleya po tuawahi hi ibaabani hi pa, “Tanona muliyei tu witaniwagena geegeka. Ta uni po geka tanona ipa ina nenae ugolina naka apo ina wigalitiyei.”
Ega yaka hi halena hopuneya tanona uputana po hi uni.’ Yesu i lubayada i pa, ‘Tanona taniwagana apo tano tu galena itete iyowai ina dewahi?
Apo ina nei po ina unihi ma tano tu galena itete gehouhi u nimahi tanona ina houni.’ Hougana geka lawa hi noonoli po hi pa, ‘Apega duma.’
Ma tauna i galehi ma i pa, ‘Heki, geka bahana Yaubada a Buka ugolina anona awai? I baheya i pa,

content.text: amalai i gunabuiya po i dewadewa lagona.”

content: Iyai ina peu po noka ogolana ugolina ina yato apo ina lauhedalena meya po tupotupona. Ma inapa noka ogolana ina guli po iyai ina lutataya apo ina lumutumutuya.’
Takisi wimihana bahabahana
Lugagayo tanitaniwagahi po tu witalaguyaba babadahi ipa noka kabudalana hina numa panipani. Matababana geka paliluwaluwana i bahena niyeya ugolihi ma tamogi lawa hi lowogehi.

Ega yaka gaogao hi beiha po lawa tu wibenabenama gowagowada hi himilihi ipa hina witepa naka tauhi tu winugonugotuhu dumalu. Ma tauhi ipa Yesu hina laubayabayadeya po ina baha powa ma mi Loma hai taniwaga baneina a witaniwaga po a wipoya ugolina hina houni.

Tu wibenabenama gowagowadahi Yesu hi lubayadeya hi pa, ‘Bada, to hanapugeya naka awai e bahebahehi po e iatatiyanehi hi dumalu. Ma gasi to hanapugeya naka lawa ega uta ikahahi ma tamogi Yaubada a nugotuhu moinana lawa ubeihi e iatatiyanehi.
Apo mi Loma hai taniwaga ta wotagoya po takisi ta huhouni Sisa binei, bo eega?’
Tamogi Yesu amaka hai lubayada koyakoyama i hanapugeya yaka ugolihi i baha i pa,
‘Mone emosi ona wogeleteya po a galeya. Iyai tepana galenana po gowana geka monena ugolina?’ Ma tauhi hi pa, ‘Sisa galenana.’
Ega yaka Yesu ugolihi i baha i pa, ‘Heki, ginouli awai Sisa galinei Sisa ona weleya. Ma ginouli awai Yaubada galinei Yaubada ona weleya.’
Lawa u matahi ega emoemotahi ipa Yesu hina dewaya po ina baha powa. Ega yaka hi genuwana ma a baha binei nugonugohi i goholi.
Towolomeme bahabahana
Sadusi hai bolu lawahi hilage towolo memena ega hita itumaganeya. Tauhi hi nei Yesu ugolina,

po hi lubayadeya hi pa, ‘Bada, Mose geka lugagayona ubeiyai i gilumi i pa, “Oloto awai ina tawine po ega ina winatuna ma ina hilage apo walehina hiwapena ina lawagi po hina winatuna naka popoyana galinei.”
Lawa gehouna natunatuna ololotohi magouhi 7. Tutuwoga i tawine po ega natuna ma i hilage.
Ma tu hulatuna wawinena i lawagi.
Po gasi tu witonugahi ma atapuhina magouhi 7 emoemotahi. Ega hita winatuna ma hi hilage pahihi.
Muliyei apoma wawinena i hilage.
Ugolinei ma hau towolo meme wawinena apo agona iyai? Matababana atapuhi magouhi 7 i lawaga pahihi.’
Ma Yesu ugolihi i baha i pa, ‘Lawa geka u hougana he mamae he tawitawine po natunatuhi he itawinehi.
Ma tamogi iyawoi noka u hougana Yaubada u matana hi dewadewa po hau hilage he towotowolo meme lawa apega hina tawitawine po apega hina itawinehi.
Matababana apega hina hilage meme babana tauhi apo mei tu winoyanoya po tauhi Yaubada natunatuna hai towolo meme binei.
Mayau towotowolona i alalahi hougana Mose i limoineya naka lawa hau hilage he towotowolo meme. Noka hougana Guyau i bahena meya tauna Abelaham a Yaubada po Isako a Yaubada po Yakobo a Yaubada.
Tauna ega lawa hilahilagehi hai Yaubada ma lawa lauyagohanahi hai Yaubada. Matababana tauna ugolina lawa atapuhi he lauyagohana.’
Ma lugagayo tanitaniwagahi gehouhi hi baha hi pa, ‘Bada, i lubayada u wimihena imahiyena dumaya.’
Ma atapuhi hi lowogeya po ega hita lubayadena meya.
Dawita gogana Besinana lawana
Tamogi Yesu i lubayadehi i pa, ‘Iyowai ma lawa hi pa Besinana lawana naka apo Dawita gogana?
Matababana Dawita tauna buka Sam ugolina i baheya i pa,

content.text: “Yaubada i baha u Guyau ugolina i pa,
a sigana am gawiya a houna hopunehi

content: Noka hougana Dawita Besinana lawana i kawaguyougeya. Ugolinei Dawita ega Besinana lawana gogana dumana.’
Lugagayo tanitaniwagahi Yesu i kawaapapoenihi
Lawa atapuhi Yesu hi lautaniganeya ma a hewahewali ugolihi i baha i pa,

‘Lugagayo tanitaniwagahi ona gagalena imahiyehi. Tauhi hai luhogala ipa luilui daodaohi hina otenihi ma hina nenae, ma ani gimala dobuna ugolina lawa wiyateyategei hina maamalihi. Tauhi hai luhogala hau numa dalabu ani tugula dewadewahi po hau toleha hai ani tugula gegehi.
Ma gasi koyamagei hiwahiwape hai numa gapolahi he danedanenehi ma lupali daodaohigei galena koyakoyama he dewadewaya. Tauhi hai wimeiha apo ina lata duma.’
